title: 第22章 炸炉与成丹
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
五柳城这几日雨水充沛，东街的青石板路被泡得松动了，踩上去吱吱作响。

    林尘到摊子的时候天刚蒙蒙亮，雾气从城外的荒林里漫进来，裹着药材铺子门口堆放的干草药，整条街闻起来像一口正在熬煮的大药锅。

    他以为自己来得早，结果棚子里已经亮了灯——苏荇比他更早，正蹲在炼丹炉前面生火。

    炉火刚燃起来，火苗还是暗红色的，她往里加了几块干柴，火光映在她脸上，把睫毛的影子拉得很长。

    “徐老还没来？”

    “去城门口拦药材了，说今天有一批从落雁谷方向来的货，要赶在隔壁摊子前面截下来。”

    苏荇把最后一块干柴塞进炉膛，站起来拍了拍手上的灰。

    “他走之前说了，让你先看丹道真解第一卷，把灵纹融合的基础理论看完。等他回来要考你，考不过就让你去隔壁摊子当学徒。”

    “隔壁摊子卖假药的？”

    “对，去那边正好专业对口。”

    苏荇难得开了个玩笑，然后从药柜上取下那本旧得起了毛边的《丹道真解》放在桌上。

    “第一卷第三章到第五章是灵纹融合的基础，你先看，我去准备今天的药材。解毒丹的配方还差一味蛇涎果，昨天那批货全被隔壁抢走了，今天师父要是再拦不到新货，这炉丹又得往后推。”

    她走到药柜前开始整理昨天剩下的药材，动作很快，手指在药柜的几十个抽屉之间来回翻飞，显然对每个抽屉里放了什么药材烂熟于心。

    林尘翻开丹道真解第一卷第三章，标题是“灵纹归经”。

    开篇第一句话就用朱砂笔圈了出来，旁边是徐老头的批注，字迹潦草得像是喝醉了酒写的：灵纹即药脉，药脉即人脉。不通人脉者不可炼丹。

    他反复看了两遍这句话，又翻到下一页。

    徐老头的批注在丹道真解上随处可见，有的地方密密麻麻写满了整页空白，有的地方只画了一个巴掌大的灵纹图解——但每一处批注都恰好出现在正文最关键的位置上，像是老头在三十年的炼丹生涯里把所有踩过的坑都提前标了出来。

    他正看得入神，系统忽然弹出一道提示，面板悬浮在眼前。

    “检测到宿主正在学习炼丹术基础理论。混沌圣体对灵力波动的感知能力可作用于药材灵纹分析——宿主可通过直接触摸药材感知其灵纹流转路径，此能力与炼丹师的‘观火镜’功能类似，但精度更高。建议宿主在学习过程中多触摸实物药材，将灵纹感知与理论知识相互印证。”

    林尘抬起头看了一眼药柜。苏荇正背对着他整理药材，淡绿色长裙的腰带在腰后打了个蝴蝶结，随着她的动作轻轻晃动。

    他站起来走到药柜前，从抽屉里取出一株干制的清心草——和昨天苏荇给他看的那株是同一批。

    他将清心草握在掌心，闭上眼。

    混沌圣体的灵力从丹田深处涌出，顺着经脉流到指尖，渗入清心草的茎叶。

    一股极其清晰的灵纹波动反馈回来——五条平行的灵纹沿着茎叶纵向排列，每条灵纹的灵力流转速度都不同，最靠近叶脉的那条流速最快，靠近叶尖的那条最慢。

    这和书上写的“五道灵纹，叶尖者缓，叶脉者急”完全吻合。

    他把清心草放回抽屉，又取出银叶花。

    银叶花的花瓣上有两道灵纹，呈螺旋状从花心往外扩散，灵力在花瓣边缘处会自然衰减——所以采摘时辰必须在卯时三刻，因为那个时间点灵纹的灵力最充沛，过了时辰灵力就会从花瓣边缘流失。

    再换蛇涎果——果皮上有三道横向的灵纹，呈环状将果实分成了三截，每截都蕴含着独立的毒素。

    高温烘烤可以让三道灵纹同时受热断裂，毒素失去灵纹的束缚后自行挥发。

    但烘烤温度不能超过三成炉火，否则灵纹会碎裂，毒素还没挥发就渗进了果肉里。

    苏荇转过身的时候，林尘已经把药柜里十几种常用药材全摸了一遍。

    她看着他手里捏着半截干制的赤蛇果，愣了一下。

    “你在干什么。”

    “摸药材。清心草灵纹是平行的，银叶花灵纹是螺旋的，蛇涎果灵纹是横向环状。赤蛇果的灵纹和蛇涎果不一样——它的灵纹是纵向的，而且只有两道，毒素集中在果核里，果肉反而没毒。所以赤蛇果不能用高温烘烤来解毒，因为高温会让果核裂开，毒素反而会渗进果肉。”

    他把赤蛇果放回抽屉，又拿起一株黑芝。

    “黑芝的灵纹是漩涡状的，十二道，和清心草的五道平行灵纹放在一起会互相抵消。但我觉得漩涡状的灵纹不一定只能配清心草——如果找到另一种灵纹也是漩涡状的药材，两种漩涡重叠在一起，说不定能产生更强的效果。”
content_en:
There has been a lot of rain in Wuliu City in the past few days, and the bluestone pavement on East Street has become loose due to soaking, making it squeak when you step on it.

    When Lin Chen arrived at the stall, it was just dawning. The mist came in from the wild forest outside the city, covering the dried herbs piled at the door of the medicinal shop. The whole street smelled like a big medicine pot being boiled.

    He thought he had arrived early, but the lights in the shed were already on - Su Yun was earlier than him and was squatting in front of the alchemy furnace to light a fire.

    The fire had just lit up, and the flames were still dark red. She added a few pieces of dry wood into it, and the firelight reflected on her face, making the shadow of her eyelashes very long.

    "Mr. Xu hasn't come yet?"

    "I went to the city gate to collect medicinal materials. They said there was a batch of goods coming from the direction of Luoyan Valley today. I had to intercept them in front of the stall next door."

    Su Yun stuffed the last piece of dry firewood into the furnace, stood up and patted the ashes on her hands.

    "He said before he left that he wanted you to read the first volume of Alchemy and the basic theory of spiritual pattern fusion. When he comes back, he will take a test for you. If you fail, he will let you become an apprentice at the stall next door."

    "The stall next door sells fake medicine?"

    "Yes, I'll meet you professionally there."

    Su Yun made a rare joke, then took the old and rough-edged "The True Explanation of Alchemy" from the medicine cabinet and placed it on the table.

    "Chapter 3 to Chapter 5 of the first volume are the basis for spiritual pattern fusion. You read it first, and I will prepare today's medicinal materials. The recipe for the antidote pill still lacks the snake saliva fruit. Yesterday's batch of goods was all snatched away by the next door. If master can't get new goods today, the furnace pill will have to be pushed back."

    She walked to the medicine cabinet and started sorting out the remaining medicinal materials from yesterday. She moved quickly, her fingers flying back and forth between the dozens of drawers in the medicine cabinet, and she was obviously very familiar with the medicinal materials placed in each drawer.

    Lin Chen opened the third chapter of the first volume of the True Explanation of Alchemy. The title was "Return of the Spirit Pattern to the Sutra".

    The first sentence at the beginning was circled with a cinnabar pen, and next to it was Old Man Xu's annotation. The handwriting was as sloppy as if it was written drunk: Spiritual patterns are medicinal veins, and medicinal veins are human connections. Those who do not have good connections cannot make elixirs.

    He read this sentence twice and turned to the next page.

    Old Man Xu’s annotations can be seen everywhere in the True Explanation of Alchemy. In some places, the whole page is filled with dense writing, and in other places, only a palm-sized spiritual pattern diagram is drawn - but every annotation happens to appear in the most critical position of the text, as if the old man has marked all the pitfalls he has stepped on in his thirty years of alchemy career.

    While he was watching intently, a prompt suddenly popped up in the system, and the panel was suspended in front of him.

    "It has been detected that the host is learning the basic theory of alchemy. The Chaos Holy Body's ability to sense spiritual power fluctuations can be used to analyze the spiritual patterns of medicinal materials - the host can sense the flow path of its spiritual patterns by directly touching the medicinal materials. This ability is similar to the alchemist's 'fire viewing mirror' function, but with higher accuracy. It is recommended that the host touches more physical medicinal materials during the learning process to corroborate spiritual pattern perception with theoretical knowledge."

    Lin Chen raised his head and glanced at the medicine cabinet. Su Yun was sorting the medicinal materials with her back to him. The belt of her light green dress was tied with a bow at the back and swayed slightly with her movements.

    He stood up and walked to the medicine cabinet, and took out a dried cordial grass from the drawer - the same one that Su Yun showed him yesterday.

    He held the Qingxincao in his palm and closed his eyes.

    The spiritual power of the Chaos Holy Body gushes out from the depths of the Dantian, flows along the meridians to the fingertips, and penetrates into the stems and leaves of Qingxincao.

    An extremely clear wave of spiritual patterns was fed back - five parallel spiritual patterns were arranged longitudinally along the stems and leaves, and the spiritual power of each spiritual pattern flowed at a different speed. The one closest to the leaf veins had the fastest flow rate, and the one near the leaf tip was the slowest.

    This is completely consistent with the "five spiritual patterns" written in the book, the ones at the tip of the leaf are slow and the veins are sharp.

    He put the Qingxincao back into the drawer and took out the Silverleaf Flower.

    There are two spiritual patterns on the petals of the silver leaf flower, which spread out from the center of the flower in a spiral shape. The spiritual power will naturally decay at the edge of the petals - so the picking time must be at the third quarter of the hour, because the spiritual power of the spiritual patterns is the most abundant at that time. After that time, the spiritual power will be lost from the edge of the petals.

    Let's switch to the snake saliva fruit - there are three horizontal spiritual lines on the peel, which divide the fruit into three parts in a ring shape, each part contains independent toxins.

    High-temperature baking can cause the three spiritual patterns to be broken by heat at the same time, and the toxins will evaporate on their own after losing the restraints of the spiritual patterns.

    However, the baking temperature should not exceed 30% of the furnace fire, otherwise the spiritual patterns will be broken and the toxins will seep into the pulp before they evaporate.

    When Su Yun turned around, Lin Chen had already touched over a dozen commonly used medicinal materials in the medicine cabinet.

    She looked at the half-dried red snake fruit in his hand and was stunned for a moment.

    "What are you doing."

    "Touch the medicinal materials. The spirit patterns of Qingxincao are parallel, the spirit patterns of Silverleaf Flower are spiral, and the spirit patterns of Snake Fruit are horizontal and circular. The spirit patterns of Red Snake Fruit are different from those of Snake Fruit - its spirit patterns are vertical, and there are only two. The toxins are concentrated in the core, but the pulp is not poisonous. Therefore, Red Snake Fruit cannot be detoxified by roasting it at high temperature, because the high temperature will cause the core to crack, and the toxins will penetrate into the pulp."

    He put the red snake fruit back into the drawer and picked up a black sesame plant.

    "The spiritual pattern of black sesame is in the shape of a swirl, with twelve lines. When put together with the five parallel spiritual patterns of Qingxincao, they will cancel each other out. But I feel that the swirling spiritual pattern is not necessarily suitable only for Qingxincao - if you find another medicinal material with a spiritual pattern that is also swirly, and the two vortices overlap, it may produce a stronger effect."
title_en: Chapter 22 Exploding the Furnace and Making the Pill
